description: This file declares a small library for managing a stack of signal handlers, allowing code to set, restore, and chain signal handlers for signals like SIGINT, SIGHUP, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT, and SIGPIPE. It provides functions to push and pop handlers for individual signals and to push/pop common signals together.

methods.name: sigchain_push
methods.description: Pushes a handler for a specific signal onto the signal handler stack.

methods.name: sigchain_pop
methods.description: Removes the top handler for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_push_common
methods.description: Pushes a handler onto the stack for a set of common signals: SIGINT, SIGHUP, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT, and SIGPIPE.

methods.name: sigchain_pop_common
methods.description: Restores previous handlers for the common signals.
